results.description:
Leaving the Navy SEALs was a tough decision but I can't live in my father's shadow forever. Joining Black Hawke Security is a no-brainer given it's full of respected paramilitary legends. I figure the job's going to be an easy ride, but I'm wrong.

A young, wealthy author from New York needs her own private security on the eve of marrying a notorious criminal. Who am I to judge? Until I meet Stella and my protective tendencies kick in, and a whole lot of sexual tension.

Something's not right and quickly I realize there's no way I can let this wedding take place… at least not over my dead body.

And it just might be.

THE FORBIDDEN BODYGUARD is book one in the Black Hawke Security - Bodyguard series, a spicy military romance. Loaded with spice and suspense, this forbidden love will keep you turning pages as this private security alpha falls head over heels for his heroine. Can be read as a standalone and it has a happy ever after.

If you've enjoyed military romances from authors Susan Stoker, Anna Hackett, Cora Seton, Sybil Bartel and Rebecca Yarros then you'll love THE FORBIDDEN BODYGUARD!
